scope: Approximately ten-year unattended battery estimation; stationary H7 is fidelity reference, not aging-qualified firmware.

target.cpu: baseline Cortex-M23 custom silicon / Verilog simulation
target.history_policy: SRAM-only; no persistent working-history requirement added

no_perfect_classifier_claim: Indistinguishable situations prohibit universal zero false authorization and zero refusal. Soundness and conditional availability are separate requirements.

claims.claim: Declared operating envelope and risk requirements
remaining: Physical and sensor bounds, rate/gap limits, aging/thermal assumptions
Lifetime risk and query-specific tolerances
Fallback load and conditional recovery deadline
Complete implementation refinement including gaps, reset and source identity
Reachable-domain/range bounds for response, feature, QR, solves and libm
Outward error accounting and overflow/conditioning behavior
Supported-horizon proof beyond finite numerical witnesses
Uniform physical/feature/derivative/transport bounds
Qualified aging and sensor/model discrepancy
Containment across weak use without arbitrary decay
Implemented joint query certificate and applicable lifetime guarantee
Validity/freshness/source guards with code correspondence
No conversion of local GN precision into claimed physical coverage
Defined excitation/viable power/sensor/drift class
Bound N_star and execution latency for certificate recovery
Bound avoidable refusal; validate against informative held-out cases
Joint voltage lower bound across entire proposed load horizon
Actuator/sensor/thermal/model margins
Qualified system fallback policy
Repair field flush partial-commit witness
Bounded local recovery or explicit quarantine before publication
Fault injection at every commit/publication boundary under stated fault model
Cold start with aged-cell support rather than original manufacturing prior
No stale evidence/certificate use after SRAM loss
Lifetime risk accounting across boots; persistence optional but must be qualified if used
Full target SRAM/stack/flash plus peak scratch liveness
Worst-case cycles, bounded retries/buffers and overflow policy
Counter conversions and any persistent-write endurance
Specify sensor bias/clipping/gaps/clock/corruption fault classes
Detection latency/power only for distinguishable faults
External qualification or conservative envelopes for unmonitorable assumptions
Per-change proof premises, fixed control and negative controls
Target compiler/ABI/build identities and matched measurements
No unchecked removal of validity or recovery logic

implementation_order: Query/status and transaction/quarantine contract; field flush repair
Small-domain conservative SOC/Q and proposed-load certificates against H7 reference
Lifetime risk, reset and bounded autonomous recovery
Target range/numerical/resource proof, then contract-preserving optimization
